# pve_vm (Data Source)

Reads one QEMU guest's effective configuration and runtime status (`GET /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/config` plus `.../status/current`). Attribute names mirror the `pve_vm` resource; unmodeled PVE config keys are not exposed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Read the effective configuration and runtime status of one QEMU guest.
data "pve_vm" "web" {
  node = "pve1"
  vmid = 100
}

output "web_status" {
  value = data.pve_vm.web.status
}

output "web_disks" {
  value = data.pve_vm.web.disks
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name the guest runs on.
- `vmid` (Number) The (unique) VM ID to read.

### Read-Only

- `agent` (Boolean) Whether the QEMU Guest Agent is enabled.
- `bios` (String) BIOS implementation (`seabios` or `ovmf`).
- `boot_order` (List of String) Boot order devices from the pin `boot` parameter (`order=a;b`).
- `cloud_init` (Attributes) Cloud-init settings from the config keys. The password is write-only in PVE and never exposed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloud_init))
- `cores` (Number) Number of cores per socket.
- `cpu_type` (String) Emulated CPU type extracted from the pin `cpu` parameter.
- `description` (String) VM description (pin `description`).
- `disks` (Attributes List) Virtual disk drives parsed from the config values. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disks))
- `id` (String) Data-source identifier in `<node>/<vmid>` form.
- `machine` (String) QEMU machine type.
- `maxcpu` (Number) Maximum usable CPUs.
- `maxmem` (Number) Maximum memory in bytes.
- `memory` (Number) Amount of online RAM in MiB.
- `name` (String) VM name (pin `name`).
- `network_interfaces` (Attributes List) Network devices parsed from the config values. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_interfaces))
- `onboot` (Boolean) Whether the VM starts during system bootup.
- `ostype` (String) Guest operating system type.
- `protection` (Boolean) Whether the protection flag is set.
- `qmpstatus` (String) VM run state from the QMP monitor (when running).
- `scsihw` (String) SCSI controller model.
- `sockets` (Number) Number of CPU sockets.
- `status` (String) QEMU process status, `running` or `stopped`.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags of the VM, split from the pin's `;`-separated `tags` string.
- `template` (Boolean) Whether the guest is a template.
- `uptime` (Number) Uptime in seconds.

<a id="nestedatt--cloud_init"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cloud_init`

Read-Only:

- `ipconfig` (Map of String) IP configurations keyed by interface (`ipconfig0`-`ipconfig31`).
- `nameserver` (String) Cloud-init DNS server.
- `searchdomain` (String) Cloud-init DNS search domains.
- `sshkeys` (String) Public SSH keys, one per line (decoded from the percent-encoded config value).
- `user` (String) Cloud-init user name (pin `ciuser`).


<a id="nestedatt--disks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `disks`

Read-Only:

- `cache` (String) Drive cache mode.
- `discard` (String) Discard/trim passthrough setting.
- `format` (String) Backing file data format.
- `id` (String) Drive key (`scsi0`, `virtio1`, `efidisk0`, ...).
- `iothread` (Boolean) Whether iothreads are used.
- `size` (String) Drive size in PVE disk-size syntax.
- `ssd` (Boolean) Whether the drive is exposed as an SSD.
- `storage` (String) Storage ID backing the drive.


<a id="nestedatt--network_interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network_interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `bridge` (String) Bridge the device attaches to.
- `firewall` (Boolean) Whether the firewall protects this interface.
- `id` (String) Device key (`net0`, ...).
- `macaddr` (String) MAC address of the device.
- `model` (String) Network card model.
- `queues` (Number) Number of packet queues.
- `vlan_tag` (Number) VLAN tag applied to packets.
